en.title: At Texas Rally, Trump and Paxton Make for an Awkward Pair
en.summary: Trump expressed support for Republican Senate candidate Paxton at a Texas rally, though he had previously expressed reservations. Trump devoted significant portions of his speech to defending his own record.

en.title: Texas executes man after lawyers sought to stop procedure, citing Christa Pike
en.summary: Jamaal Howard was executed by lethal injection in Texas despite legal efforts to halt the procedure, with his attorneys citing concerns based on a failed execution case involving Christa Pike.

stories.title: Christa Pike, Confused After Failed Tennessee Execution, Is at Center of Legal Storm

en.title: Christa Pike, Confused After Failed Tennessee Execution, Is at Center of Legal Storm
en.summary: A Tennessee inmate survived an execution attempt, raising ethical and legal questions about her awareness and condition following the failed procedure for a decades-old murder conviction.

stories.title: Christa Pike has pneumonia, unable to move arms after botched execution

en.title: Christa Pike has pneumonia, unable to move arms after botched execution
en.summary: Attorneys reported that a Tennessee inmate who survived two lethal injections during a failed execution has developed pneumonia and cannot move her arms.

en.title: What Christa Pike asked when she woke up from failed execution
en.summary: Attorneys claim Tennessee prison officials delayed granting them access to their client for over two hours after she regained consciousness following an unsuccessful execution attempt.

stories.title: Inmate 'angry and confused' after botched execution

en.title: Inmate 'angry and confused' after botched execution
en.summary: Lawyers for a death row inmate expressed shock when their client regained consciousness and began speaking after a failed execution in Tennessee.

stories.title: Judge orders that Christa Pike execution evidence be preserved

en.title: Judge orders that Christa Pike execution evidence be preserved
en.summary: A judge ordered evidence preservation in Christa Pike's failed execution case. Pike remains awake but is described as angry and confused following the incident.

stories.title: Judge orders Tennessee to preserve evidence in failed execution of Christa Pike

en.title: Judge orders Tennessee to preserve evidence in failed execution of Christa Pike
en.summary: A judge ordered Tennessee to preserve evidence from Christa Pike's failed execution. Pike's attorney noted that she is currently angry and confused.

stories.title: Christa Pike somehow survived her execution. What happens next?

en.title: Christa Pike somehow survived her execution. What happens next?
en.summary: Christa Pike survived her execution and remains hospitalized under guard. Her legal team plans to seek commutation of her sentence to life imprisonment without parole.

stories.title: Christa Pike is conscious and speaking after failed execution, attorneys say

en.title: Christa Pike is conscious and speaking after failed execution, attorneys say
en.summary: Christa Pike remains hospitalized after Tennessee's unsuccessful lethal injection execution attempt last week, and is now conscious and communicating.
